map.混响室体积 V=200 m³，空室混响时间 T0=6.0 s，铺装 S=10 m: Reverberation room V=200 m3, empty-room RT T0=6.0 s; after laying specimen S=10 m2, T1=4.5 s. From A=0.161V/T the empty-room absorption A0=53.7 sabins, after laying A1=71.6 sabins, specimen contribution dA=17.9, absorption coefficient a=dA/S=1.79 (>1 is a normal upper bound due to edge and mounting conditions).
map.实验室实测常出现 α>1，源于安装方式、边缘效应与测试不确定度；工程取值一般按标: a>1 is common in lab measurements due to mounting, edge effects and test uncertainty; engineering practice uses the single value under standard conditions, not extremes.
map.赛宾与 ISO 354 的关系？: What is the relation between Sabine and ISO 354?
map.ISO 354 用混响室法测定建筑制品吸声系数，其计算基础就是赛宾公式与吸声量换: ISO 354 determines building-product absorption in a reverberation room; its computation rests on the Sabine formula and absorption conversion, and is the source standard for reported coefficients.
